sv.title: Strömningstjänsten SkyShowtime läggs ned
sv.summary: SkyShowtime läggs ned. Strömningstjänsten, där prinsessan Madeleines nya serie ska visas, försvinner i bland annat Sverige i slutet av 2027, skriver Hollywood Reporter.

en.title: Streaming service SkyShowtime is shut down
en.summary: SkyShowtime is being shut down. The streaming service, where Princess Madeleine's new series is set to air, will disappear in Sweden and other markets at the end of 2027, writes The Hollywood Reporter.
